ledger: Man in striped shirt | stands facing camera in front of wood-paneled doorway | turns to his right (viewer's left) and knocks on the perpendicular wooden door | camera pans left with him from 00:07 to 00:09

Center background wooden door/wall | has two upper panels: left panel holds a hook with a blue coat and a brass medallion above it, right panel (behind man's head) is bare wood; bordered on the right by a narrow wall strip with a switch and on the left by a dark recess/gap | right panel next to the blue coat suddenly contains a framed picture, and the left side connects directly to the perpendicular door without the dark gap | layout morphs during camera pan between 00:07 and 00:08

Right-side wall strip and adjacent panel | narrow wallpaper strip with brass switch plate separating the center door from a far-right wood panel holding a framed picture | pans off-screen to the right after 00:07 | framed picture effectively shifts onto the center door's right panel at 00:08

Left perpendicular wooden door | visible at far left edge separated from the back door by a dark recess/opening | man walks up to it and knocks on it, revealing a wall strip with switches and bells to its left | corner geometry between it and the back wall changes during the pan at 00:07-00:08

findings.entity: Center background wooden panel (to the right of the hanging blue coat)
findings.description: From 00:00 to 00:07, the recessed wooden panel immediately to the right of the hanging blue coat (directly behind the man's head) is bare wood, while a framed picture hangs on a separate wooden structure further to the right across a strip of wall with a switch. As the camera pans left between 00:07 and 00:08, a framed picture abruptly appears inside that previously bare panel right next to the blue coat.

findings.entity: Corner geometry to the left of the hanging blue coat
findings.description: From 00:00 to 00:07, there is a dark vertical gap/recess between the door casing behind the blue coat and the perpendicular wooden door on the left. During the leftward camera pan at 00:08, this dark gap disappears and the wood paneling behind the coat joins directly into a solid wooden corner with the door the man knocks on.
